column3: Spend is attributed per feature at flush time from each conversation's pi.usage growth (usage_feature table, usage.marks in kv); background calls are charged into pi.usage under a <feature>: key prefix; per-feature caps are checked where work starts (message.send, delegate_task, goal rounds, Dreamer, compaction) rather than in a GenerationTask hook
